name: Mobis Parts America PDC - Lawrenceville GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open multi-tenant industrial park (Breckinridge Industrial Park). Street View drove freely into the shared dock court; no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint at any property/road interface.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure anywhere at the building or court entrance.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailers parked without tractors along the dock face and in the shared central yard area between buildings.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~38 estimated along the NW dock face of the Mobis building; multi-tenant building so exact Mobis-allocated count uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Open park road network — no defined gate, so entry/exit lane flags left false; trucks circulate freely.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Central park yard and dock-face trailer storage; estimate 10-25 drop trailers attributable to this building.
